platform: SolidEdge Cloud Platform (SECP) — Engineering Truth OS

capabilities.name: PCB Canonical Model & Layout Verification
capabilities.knownLimitations: Assumes rigid planar substrates (FR4/Polyimide); flexible PCB bending radii physics not yet integrated.
capabilities.missingRequirements: IPC-6012 Class 3 / MIL-PRF-31032 aerospace substrate qualification rules.
capabilities.recommendedNextAction: Bind to Phase 5 QualificationRequirement schema with Class 3 acceptance criteria.

capabilities.name: Electrical Nodal Circuit Solver (MNA) & Power Balancing
capabilities.executionPath: NodalCircuitSolver.solve(model) -> compute Branch Currents & Power Balance
evidenceReferences: Residual power balance residual < 1e-12 W in verify_multidomain_pcb.ts
capabilities.knownLimitations: Linear DC steady-state analysis only. AC frequency response, transmission line effects, and inductive switching transients not modeled.
capabilities.missingRequirements: DO-160 Section 16/17 power input transient tolerance and lightning surge modeling.
capabilities.recommendedNextAction: Document validity envelope strictly as DC steady-state; declare transient/RF as NOT_PROVEN.

capabilities.name: Copper Trace DC Resistance & Voltage Drop Evaluation
capabilities.knownLimitations: Uniform cross-section DC conduction assumption. No AC skin-depth or high-frequency current crowding.
capabilities.missingRequirements: IPC-2152 temperature-rise charts for internal vs external layers under continuous altitude derating.
capabilities.recommendedNextAction: Add environmental ambient derating factors for high-altitude aerospace profiles.

capabilities.name: Wiring Harness Electrical & Interconnect Verification
capabilities.knownLimitations: Assumes point-to-point harness topology. High-voltage insulation breakdown (corona discharge at altitude) not computed.
capabilities.missingRequirements: SAE AS50881 / MIL-W-5088L aerospace harness installation & bundle derating verification.
capabilities.recommendedNextAction: Integrate bundle grouping derating factor and altitude pressure correction.

capabilities.name: MCAD Enclosure Standoff & Clearance Keepout Verification
capabilities.knownLimitations: Rigid body interference detection only. Elastic deflection under aerodynamic/gravitational G-loads not evaluated.
capabilities.missingRequirements: DO-160 Section 8 structural vibration resonance and sustained G-load clearance.
capabilities.recommendedNextAction: Distinguish geometric clearance from dynamic deflection; mark structural deformation as NOT_PROVEN.

capabilities.name: Thermal Junction Temperature & Joule Heating Estimation
capabilities.knownLimitations: 1D lumped parameter thermal model. Does not solve 3D Navier-Stokes airflow or conjugate heat transfer.
capabilities.missingRequirements: DO-160 Section 4 temperature/altitude operating extremes (-55°C to +85°C with solar radiation).
capabilities.recommendedNextAction: Explicitly register model as 0D/1D Lumped-Parameter in solver-validity-register.json; disallow claiming 3D CFD.

capabilities.name: Unified Cross-Domain Manufacturing BOM Reconciliation
capabilities.knownLimitations: Matches by standard component part numbers. Vendor obsolescence (PCN) and supply chain lead times not queried live.
capabilities.missingRequirements: Aerospace traceability to lot numbers and certificates of conformance (CoC).
capabilities.recommendedNextAction: Add traceability fields for manufacturing lot and qualification test unit serials.

capabilities.name: Deterministic Hash & Cryptographic Merkle Evidence Tree
evidenceReferences: Hash f655ebf3c5b986975a285d8aaefdd81ca69d12384976aa0f2495d03bb630739c verified invariant to array key sorting
capabilities.knownLimitations: Proves cryptographic non-tampering of recorded payload; does not validate underlying physical assumptions.
capabilities.missingRequirements: Binding to external qualification standard clause numbers.
capabilities.recommendedNextAction: Retain as cryptographic foundation; bind Merkle leaves directly to QualificationRequirement IDs.

capabilities.name: Design Mutation Detection & Evidence Invalidation
capabilities.executionPath: Mutate design -> Re-run gate -> Detect digest mismatch -> Invalidate previous evidence
capabilities.knownLimitations: Currently executed via test harness scripts; automated background cascade daemon pending P5.7 integration.
capabilities.missingRequirements: Automated system-level status transition from VALID to INVALIDATED in durable storage on git commit.

capabilities.name: Structural Vibration, Modal Analysis & Shock Dynamics
evidenceReferences: None in Multidomain PCB Integration (Not integrated in Phase 4 gate)
capabilities.knownLimitations: Solvers exist in isolation but are not bound into MultidomainPcbIntegrationEngine or Acceptance Gates.
capabilities.missingRequirements: End-to-end integration of random vibration profiles (MIL-STD-810H / DO-160 Section 8) with PCB mounting standoffs.
capabilities.recommendedNextAction: Explicitly record as GAP-P5-004; designate structural qualification as NOT_PROVEN in Phase 5 baseline.

capabilities.name: Functional Safety & Failure Modes Effects Analysis (FMEA)
capabilities.authoritativeEngine: None formally bound at multidomain system level
capabilities.knownLimitations: Software tests verify logic mutations, but no quantitative hardware FMEA/FMECA or FTA engine is active.
capabilities.missingRequirements: MIL-HDBK-217F / Siemens SN 29500 reliability prediction and ISO 26262 ASIL hazard analysis.
capabilities.recommendedNextAction: Record as GAP-P5-005; disallow claiming functional safety qualification without quantitative models.

capabilities.name: DO-254 / DO-178C Airborne Systems Qualification Traceability
canonicalInputs: Plan for Hardware Aspects of Certification (PHAC)
capabilities.knownLimitations: SECP provides engineering evidence; it does not constitute FAA/EASA certification authority.
capabilities.missingRequirements: Traceable qualification data package aligned with DO-254 Design Assurance Levels (DAL A-E).
capabilities.recommendedNextAction: Enforce status as NOT_PROVEN in all certificates until formal qualification package is generated.

capabilities.name: ISO 26262 ASIL D Automotive Functional Safety Qualification
capabilities.knownLimitations: No ASIL D hardware metrics (SPFM, LFM, PMHF) computed from canonical components.
capabilities.missingRequirements: Quantitative safety mechanism diagnostic coverage modeling.
capabilities.recommendedNextAction: Enforce status as NOT_PROVEN; prohibit marketing labels claiming ASIL compliance.

capabilities.name: System-Level Qualification Engine (Aircraft & Industrial)
capabilities.executionPath: SystemQualificationEngine.evaluateSystem(system) -> Gate Evaluation -> RTM Mapping -> Merkle Root
capabilities.knownLimitations: Decision bounded by declared scope: steady-state DC, lumped Theta-JA thermal, and rigid kinematic MCAD only.
capabilities.missingRequirements: Full 3D CFD, random vibration FEA, and hardware FMEA models remain designated NOT_PROVEN.

capabilities.name: Engineering System Canonical Root Entity (ECU Reference Assembly)
evidenceReferences: SECP-REF-ECU-001 benchmark assembly verified in system_qualification.test.ts
capabilities.knownLimitations: Benchmark instantiated as 4-layer IPC-6012 Class 3 rigid ECU.
capabilities.recommendedNextAction: Expand to additional avionics configurations as needed.

capabilities.name: Automated Cross-Domain Revision Invalidation Cascade
evidenceReferences: ADV-CAS-001 & ADV-CAS-002: Stale evidence rejected and blocked
capabilities.knownLimitations: Fingerprint is computed across ECAD, Electrical, Harness, MCAD, Thermal, and BOM.
capabilities.recommendedNextAction: Continuous trigger on design revision creation.

capabilities.recommendedNextAction: Publish to project root and UI dashboard.
